D.t: Bennie Thompson leads by 46.2 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 114,092 votes; a one point swing is about 1,234 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +36.9 and D +55.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.4M cash against $36K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
